pages.title: Forgotten Legion Staff
pages.text: Crafted from a banner pole once held by the original Solstice Legion, the staff radiates with ancient loyalty and fractured oaths. Its wood is scorched by Mythos storms, and its tip holds a shard of a fallen Crystal. No one remembers the full story of the Legion that first wielded it. But the staff remembers everything.

pages.title: Shaped Recipe
pages.text: This staff can house a single Mythos Crystal, altering its behavior depending on the crystal used. Requires a reserve of 64 Mythos, casts at a cost of 16 Mythos.

pages.title: Crystal Fire
pages.text: Emits a flaming wave, setting nearby foes ablaze.

pages.title: Crystal Memory
pages.text: Disrupts invisibility, revealing hidden foes with a wave of primal clarity.

pages.title: Crystal Oath
pages.text: Uplifts allies with strength and resistance, calling upon ancient pacts.

pages.title: Crystal Woe
pages.text: Drains the strength of your enemies, afflicting them with Weakness.

pages.title: Crystal Grief
pages.text: Dampens movement and vision, slowing and blinding enemies in shadowy radius.
